xmldoc.short_description: Set and get property access with case-sensitive names.

param_input_item.param_description: a handle object of a class deriving from nelson.mixin.SetGetExactNames.
a property name (char or string), or a cell array of names, spelled with the exact case.

description.p: Derive a handle class from nelson.mixin.SetGetExactNames to give it set and get methods for reading and writing properties by name. It behaves exactly like nelson.mixin.SetGet, from which it derives, except that property names are matched case-sensitively: a name that differs from the declared property only in case is rejected.
set(obj, name, value) assigns a property; set(obj, n1, v1, n2, v2, ...) assigns several. get(obj, name) returns a property value; get(obj) returns a structure of all properties.

example_item.example_item_data: classdef Widget < nelson.mixin.SetGetExactNames properties Width = 0 Height = 0 end end w = Widget(); set(w, 'Width', 100); get(w, 'Width') % returns 100 get(w, 'width') % error: 'width' is not the declared name 'Width'
